title: FridgeLuck recipe taste-signal events v1
description: Events the recipe system emits as input to on-device taste learning. The taste profile itself is owned by the taste-residual-v1 spec (PR #146); this contract fixes only the event envelope so the recipe bundle, cooking sessions, and the learning service agree on vocabulary. Events never leave the phone; they exist only for LearningService replay and evaluation corpora.

type.description: suggestion_dismissed carries reason; recipe_rated carries rating.

recipe_revision.description: Bundle revision the device held at event time. Example: 1

household_id.description: Opaque local household id. Example: hh-3f9c2ab41d07

member_id.description: Opaque member id when attribution is known; null for household-level events.

occurred_at.description: Device-local instant, ISO 8601 with offset. Example: 2026-10-12T18:41:00Z

source.description: Where the interaction originated. Example: cooking_session

rating.description: Required for recipe_rated, null otherwise. Example: 4

dismiss_reason.description: Required for suggestion_dismissed, null otherwise. Example: missing_ingredient

scaled_servings.description: Servings actually cooked when it differs from the bundle. Example: 3

from_key.description: Canonical key swapped out. Example: cilantro

to_key.description: Canonical key swapped in. Example: lemon

substitutions.description: Required for cook_completed when substitutions were made; null otherwise. Example: [{from_key: cilantro, to_key: lemon}]
